items.exampleEn: We stayed in a small cabin by the lake.
items.exampleZh: 我們住在湖邊的一間小木屋。

items.exampleEn: The city gives hot meals to homeless people in winter.
items.exampleZh: 冬天時，市政府會提供熱食給無家可歸的人。

items.exampleEn: I need a hammer and some nails to fix the shelf.
items.exampleZh: 我需要一把鐵鎚和幾根釘子來修架子。

items.exampleEn: The shop moved its kitchen to the basement.
items.exampleZh: 那家店把廚房搬到地下室。

items.exampleEn: I can't sleep without my soft pillow.
items.exampleZh: 沒有我的軟枕頭，我就睡不著。

items.exampleEn: There was trash all over the beach after the festival.
items.exampleZh: 節慶過後，海灘上到處都是垃圾。

items.exampleEn: He climbed the ladder to clean the roof.
items.exampleZh: 他爬上梯子去清理屋頂。

items.exampleEn: Rubber trees grow in hot countries.
items.exampleZh: 橡膠樹生長在炎熱的國家。

items.sentenceEn: Hang the picture on that nail, please.
items.sentenceZh: 請把畫掛在那根釘子上。

items.audioEn: Hold the ladder for me while I change the light.
items.audioZh: 我換燈的時候，幫我扶著梯子。

items.sentenceEn: She bites her nails when she is nervous.
Throw the old pillow in the trash.

items.stemEn: Rain boots are usually made of ____.
Use the ____ to reach the top shelf.
items.stemZh: 用梯子去拿最上層架子的東西。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family rented a wooden cabin in the mountains. It had a small basement full of old things: a ladder, rubber boots, and a box of nails. The beds were comfortable, but the pillows were too hard, so we bought new ones in town. The owner asked us to put plastic and paper trash in different bins. In town, we also met a homeless man who sold beautiful drawings. My father bought two of them, and they are now hanging in our living room.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家在山上租了一間木屋。屋裡有個小地下室，堆滿了舊東西：一把梯子、幾雙橡膠靴，還有一盒釘子。床很舒服，但枕頭太硬了，所以我們到鎮上買了新的。屋主請我們把塑膠和紙類垃圾分開丟進不同的桶子。在鎮上，我們還遇到一位無家可歸的男士在賣很漂亮的畫。爸爸買了兩幅，現在就掛在我們家客廳。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼去鎮上買枕頭？

items.promptZh: 我們的地下室又冷又暗。
referenceEn: Our basement is cold and dark.
It is cold and dark in our basement.
rubricZh: 「又⋯又⋯」可用 and 連接（例如 cold and dark）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 trash 造一個句子，說說你家怎麼處理垃圾。
referenceEn: My family takes out the trash every evening.
I put the trash outside on Tuesdays.
rubricZh: trash 是不可數名詞「垃圾」，不加 s
例如 take out the trash、put the trash outside 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
